Recorded claim:
For the recorded BCT3 accessibility work, the user explicitly rejected disabling `keyNav` or suppressing checks as a substitute for fixing controls. Trace the real focus path and keep controls keyboard accessible when addressing those failures. This preference applies to that accessibility repair scope; it does not establish the cause of every failing test.
